The solid is an **oblique cylinder**. 

Notice the following:

- The solid has two parallel circular bases. So, it's a cylinder.

- The axis that passes through the centers of the circles is not perpendicular to the bases. So, it's oblique, not right.
html:
The solid is an oblique cylinder.

Notice the following:

  • The solid has two parallel circular bases. So, it's a cylinder.

  • The axis that passes through the centers of the circles is not perpendicular to the bases. So, it's oblique, not right.
